user.title: Sign in to Sub-Zero
user.description: Use the email and password for your Sub-Zero Group Owner account. Your password is used to sign in and is not saved.

mfa_challenge.title: Multi-factor authentication
mfa_challenge.description: Sub-Zero requires verification for {masked_phone}. Choose how to verify your sign-in.{captcha_image}

mfa_code.title: Enter verification code
mfa_code.description: Enter the 6-digit verification code sent to {masked_phone}, or leave the field blank and submit to go back and choose a verification method.

device.title: Select appliances
device.description: Choose the appliances to include in Home Assistant. You can change this selection later using Configure.

progress.wait_for_call: Answer the call to {masked_phone} and press # to verify.

error.invalid_auth: Sub-Zero did not accept the sign-in details, or the sign-in session expired. Try signing in again.
error.invalid_captcha: The characters did not match the CAPTCHA challenge. Please try again with the new image.
error.invalid_mfa_code: The verification code was not accepted. Check the code and try again, or leave the field blank and submit to go back and choose a verification method.
error.mfa_code_expired: The verification code expired or was rejected too many times. Choose a verification method to try again.
error.mfa_call_failed: The verification phone call did not complete. Choose a verification method to try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Sub-Zero. Try again later.
error.rate_limited: Sub-Zero asked us to slow down. Wait before trying again.
error.verification_required: This account requires an additional verification step that this integration does not support.

abort.already_configured: This account is already configured. Open Configure on its existing Sub-Zero entry to add appliances.
abort.all_configured: These appliances are already managed by another Sub-Zero entry.
abort.no_appliances: No connected appliances were found on this account.
abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the original Sub-Zero account.

firebase_alerts_failing.title: Firebase appliance alerts aren't working
firebase_alerts_failing.description: Firebase appliance alerts have failed repeatedly. Latest problem: {problem}. This channel is separate from regular appliance updates, and the integration keeps retrying. To stop, turn off **Firebase appliance alerts** in **Configure**.

read_status.name: Read appliance status
read_status.description: Read and confirm current appliance state before continuing. Fails if the appliance cannot be read, or if its state changes or the live connection drops or reconnects during the read.

schedule_ice_delay.name: Schedule ice delay
schedule_ice_delay.description: Pause a dedicated ice maker for 1 to 12 hours, starting now or within the next 24 hours.

device_id.name: Ice maker
device_id.description: The dedicated ice maker to pause.

start_in.name: Start in
start_in.description: Minutes until the pause begins. Zero starts now.

init.title: Appliances and updates
init.description: The list is refreshed from your Sub-Zero account. Deselecting an appliance removes its Home Assistant device and entities. Periodic state checks help recover missed updates. Optional Firebase appliance alerts use a separate notification channel; sensor values still come from appliance status updates.

error.cannot_connect: Could not refresh the appliance list. You can still configure the saved appliances below, or reopen Configure later to try again.
error.cannot_connect_no_saved: Could not refresh the appliance list, and there are no saved appliances to configure. Submit to try again, or try again later.
error.rate_limited: Sub-Zero asked us to slow down. You can still configure the saved appliances below, or wait and reopen Configure to refresh the list.
error.rate_limited_no_saved: Sub-Zero asked us to slow down, and there are no saved appliances to configure. Wait before submitting to try again.

abort.reauth_required: Sign in again using Home Assistant's Sub-Zero sign-in prompt, then reopen Configure.
abort.all_configured: These appliances are already managed by another Sub-Zero entry. Reopen Configure to refresh the list.

state.wine_temperature_alert: Wine storage temperature out of range
state.ice_cleaning_due_soon: Ice maker clean cycle due soon
state.ice_cleaning_add_descaler: Ice maker clean cycle needs descaler
state.ice_cleaning_add_sanitizer: Ice maker clean cycle needs sanitizer
state.kitchen_timer_under_one_minute: Kitchen timer has one minute remaining
state.kitchen_timer_2_under_one_minute: Kitchen timer 2 has one minute remaining
state.oven_cooking_timer_under_one_minute: Oven cooking timer has one minute remaining
state.lower_oven_cooking_timer_under_one_minut: Lower oven cooking timer has one minute remaining
state.lower_oven_probe_within_ten_degrees: Lower oven probe within 10°F of target
